features: HistoricalTraining schema v3 DMI Expert is now consumed by the live probability_reader without changing S0.5/S1/S2/S3 definitions
Legacy BB/HA Level 1-5 matching remains the base model; DMI Expert independently corrects the four-way success/alive/true-fail/other distribution
Live DMI features match HistoricalTraining: DI relation, 20-axis zone, DI gap and slopes, ADX and ADX slope, plus 4H DMI relation age for cross_momentum
DMI magnitude/slope/ADX LOW-MID-HIGH bins come from each state's learned terciles in probability_model.json; no fixed bullish threshold is invented
DMI facet likelihood ratios use the same reliability-weighted geometric-mean combiner as HistoricalTraining v3
If a v1/v2 active model is loaded, or a DMI facet cannot be matched safely, probability_reader falls back to the existing legacy probability behavior
DMI relation age is replayed from recent 4H cutoffs without look-ahead; cross_momentum is skipped if replayed relation disagrees with current DMI relation
ADX/DMI formula, S-state scoring rules, Worker/R2 routes, scheduling, sector flow, news and Champion/Challenger promotion rules are unchanged
